engine_notes: Android implements CTC Viterbi itself (blank=0), matching src/autosync/alignment/ctc.py::forced_align. No CTC code is shipped.

input.name: input_values
input.preprocessing: raw 16k mono PCM in [-1,1]; zero-mean unit-var normalization is baked into the graph

text.normalization: NFKC -> curly quotes to ' -> drop [^A-Za-z0-9' ] -> collapse spaces -> upper (src/autosync/lyrics/normalize.py::normalize_en)

accuracy.notes: MAE is INT8-vs-FP32 consistency, NOT accuracy against a human reference. INT8 shifts CTC boundaries by about 0.12 s on real songs; see android_export/en/QUANTIZATION_NOTES.md.
